title: 第5章 蛇妖洞之战(上)
content_zh:
“呜……呜……呜……呜……”雄壮却带着凄厉的陌生号角声回荡在坎源山，山中的雷豪听见了之后脸色一变，快速的召集手下的二十三小队朝洞外的操练场赶去。

雷豪进入妖群中站定，看着从洞中急速奔出来冲进去妖军的妖兵越来越少，石台上的号角却还在不停的吹着就更加肯定了雷豪心中的想法。也许，大概，今天就要攻打蛇妖洞了吧。

雷豪的心一点点的下沉，不知道他操练的战阵会不会有用，他手下的这五十弟兄今天有多少会活下，他会不会活下来，他真的不知道。

战场，充满了无尽变数的战场是他一个生活在21世界河蟹社会的大学生能完全掌握的么？但是一个变数就可能把他和二十三小队的弟兄们全数留在战场。

水脏洞洞口的阴影中慢慢出现了一个高大身影，当明净的阳光洒在这道身影的披挂上反射出刺眼的光芒之后，狂涌而出的彪悍气势看得雷豪心中就是一声喝彩。

西游记里最先出场的配角，出了名的一大混妖混世魔王此时看上去却是如此的威严恐怖，身上充满了王者的威压。

感受这威压，雷豪心里直犯嘀咕“这是混世魔王还是牛魔王啊，看上去这么牛B，这个世界的水果然很深啊，吴大大的书不能尽信啊，不然怎么死的都不知道。”

“儿郎们，蛇妖洞那群软骨头屡次犯我水脏洞，杀我水脏洞众多的妖军，今天大王带你们去把那群软骨头杀干净。”混世魔王的声音很浑厚，只是淡漠得几乎不带丝毫感情，语速不快却有一众蛊惑的味道。

“跟着大王，杀软骨头。”混世魔王话音刚落下面的妖兵立刻沸腾了，就连雷豪都差点跟着呼喊，觉得不太对的他用强大的意志力克制住了，转过头看到了手下的50个小妖，也全都声嘶力竭的在呼喊，小狐狸都直接在尖叫了。雷豪心中后怕“好可怕的蛊惑力。”雷豪不愿意被任何人控制他的思维，一秒钟都不愿意。

“走。”混世魔王大喝一声直接架起一阵黑色的妖风卷起水脏洞三千多妖军向北方飞走。

雷豪在漆黑妖风中浮浮沉沉，神志也有点不清楚，心里却在大叫：“尼玛，坑爹啊，这还是一出场就被猴哥一把捏死的混世魔王？你确定这不是牛魔王？不是青狮王？不是九灵元圣？这只是一个小小的混世魔王？”

当雷豪回过神来的时候就远远的看见有一洞府，洞府上写着“蛇妖洞”三个大字。脚底下也是和水脏洞面前的操练场一样的一大块空地。周围一马平川，雷豪偷偷的朝后面的牛九十二，小狐狸等比了一个手势，众妖兵就机灵的迅速靠过来结成了他们训练好几天的战阵。有了雷豪训练他们列队的前因，操练这个战阵到是没花太多的时间就基本上成型了，只是管不管用还得等会才能知道。雷豪身后的弟兄都没注意，他的手心汗湿了。

“软骨头，你混世魔王爷爷上门来看你了，怎么还不打开门迎接。”混世魔王的声音不大，但却是不管离他多远声音都像是在你耳边说话一样。

“嘶……原来是你这个浑身裹大粪的玩意儿，还敢杀上本王的洞府……嘶，你身上的伤好了么？”洞门慢慢打开，首先走出来的不是青面獠牙的妖怪，却是一个阴柔的中年人。只是一说话嘴里吐出一条又长又窄尖端开叉的舌头，很像蛇的舌头，看上去分外恐怖。他应该就是青蛇王了。静静跟在蛇妖王后面的是蛇妖洞的小妖，数不清的小妖从青蛇王的身旁源源不断的向外涌，不一会就形成了一片和水脏洞妖军差不多的妖军。

混世魔王一听青蛇王说他的伤，立马就怒了。“你个软骨头死泥鳅，我不欲与你逞这等口舌之力，咱们还是手底下见真章吧！”说完混世魔王就劈出了一刀，抬手的时候混世魔王还在水脏洞三千妖军前方，劈出去的时候混世魔王刀锋直接跨却了数百丈的距离出现在了青蛇王胸前。

青蛇王双眼精光爆闪，“原来你突破了，难怪敢打上门来，你是妖王？那也是妖王中最垫底的货色。”

青蛇王右手凭空出现一把青光四射的长剑抵住了混世魔王的大刀，一个闪烁直接出现在高空中。

“混世魔王，我现在承认你配做我的对手，来吧，让我好好的掂量掂量你的实力。”滚滚的声浪从高空之中传来。

被青妖王轻描淡写的挡了一招的混世魔王一脸的阴沉，对着水脏洞众妖大喝一声：“儿郎们，杀。”然后也一个闪烁出现在了半空之中。虽然蛇妖洞的小妖就在他身旁，哪怕他一出手就可以像割麦子一样杀死一大片蛇妖，但混世魔王却连眼神都没有在这群蛇妖身上停留。他是妖王，妖王就有妖王的气度。

水脏洞四大统领一听自家大王的大喝，也都大喝一声：“小的们，跟我冲，杀光这群软骨头。”然后水脏洞三千小妖就在这四位大统领的带领下……就像雷豪前世看的《古惑仔》一样一窝蜂的就冲了上去。虽然雷豪早就想到了是这个场景，却还是被这个场景雷得目瞪口呆。

“现在才知道没文化真可怕，这些小妖连当地球上的小流氓都不合格。地球上连玩个魔兽还得分肉盾，伤害输出和治疗呢……”挤在妖群中的雷豪看着这个场景脑海中却浮现出一些乱起八糟的想法。

“牛九十二，虎八十七，你们跟紧我，后面的弟兄也都跟紧我……砍死他们。”招呼身后妖兵的雷豪突然就想到了在地球上和那几个兄弟一起打群架，不也是这么什么都不管不顾顶着敌人就向前冲么?只是不同的是，这不是打架，是要妖的命。

接近了，接近了，雷豪已经能看清楚蛇妖洞的那些蛇妖脸上的细小鳞片和尖利的獠牙，他心跳越来越快，手中的狼牙棒也开始轻轻的颤抖，平时轻若无物的狼牙棒现在就好像有几千斤重一样。

“真要杀了他们吗？真要杀了他们吗？”人形的小妖很容易让雷豪陷入了被前世二十几年河蟹生活所编织的笼子里。

水脏洞妖军和蛇妖洞妖军终于交汇了，就像是两条大河从相反的方向历经了千辛万苦终于交汇在一起，迸发出了红色的美丽浪花。

雷豪终于冲出了水脏洞妖军的包裹，在他眼中满世界的蛇妖都好像挤进了他的视线。一只满脸黑色鳞片下身还是蛇型的妖兵一刀砍向了雷豪，那一刀在雷豪的眼睛里好像是慢动作一样一点点变慢，他只要一侧身就可以用狼牙棒砸死那蛇妖，但雷豪眼神闪烁了一下，侧着躲过了刀锋却没有挥出他的狼牙棒。

他躲了不要紧，这一刀直接劈在了护卫着雷豪右边的牛九十二左臂上，因为有雷豪没有顾着左边的牛九十二显然没有搞清楚是个什么情况，承受了劈在他左臂的这一刀，转过头看了看雷豪，憨实的眼神略有些迷茫。

雷豪却一下子惊呆了，在他眼中整个世界都慢了下来，只剩下牛九十二左肩上迸出的鲜红的血一直发出‘斯斯’声，雷豪的脑海中仿佛什么被打碎了一样，直接当机了一秒，然后下一秒雷豪口中发出了受伤孤狼冲向狮群一样的嚎叫：“杀，杀，杀。”转身直接一狼牙棒砸在了黑脸的蛇妖身上，把那蛇妖上身直接拍成一团血雾，下半截身子飞向冲来的蛇妖群中。

那些蛇妖也被这强大的攻击震摄了，都有些恐惧的看着雷豪，但没过几秒就有蛇妖忍不住攻击的欲望再次冲向雷豪。

疯狂中的雷豪直接用狼牙棒论出了一个乌黑闪亮的半圆，半圆内竟然直接爆出了几蓬血雾，被雷豪清出了一片空地，在妖挤妖的战场中心这是多么不可思议的事。

在这里又不得不说说小妖的实力问题，小妖是被成气候的妖王用启蒙术直接召唤野兽的畸形妖怪，是处于妖族实力金字塔最底层的小蚂蚁。一般的小妖也就相当于一个成年人类男子的战斗力，有的还不如，简单训练一下的小妖拥有人类士兵的实力，可以打两个到三个一般的小妖。严格训练的小妖就用有古代三流水准的武将。可以打十个一般的小妖。像雷豪这样的就属于妖孽了，他的力量在小妖中已经是属于最顶尖的存在，只是力量不等于实力，不一定能完全发挥出来。

小妖偶尔有智商高一点的都是什么狐妖，兔妖之类的，先天不足，留不住灵气的肉身也没多大发展潜力。像虎妖，狮妖，牛妖等等这样的肉身有天赋的妖族又很难有较高的智商，根本就不知道可以去熬炼肉身。像雷豪这样既有高智商又有强横肉身的小妖很少很少，能像雷豪一样坚持打熬肉身的小妖就更少更少了。

双眼血红的雷豪用狼牙棒扫出一个半圆之后也不停留，直接挥舞着狼牙棒就冲了上去，虽然没有什么棒法，但是有雷豪的巨力哪怕是最简单的直砸，横轮也发挥出了恐怖的杀伤力，都没有遇到过能接他一狼牙棒的敌人，巨大的狼牙棒带起一片模糊的棒影在蛇妖军中上下翻飞。

此时，由雷豪带领呈三角状战阵的二十三小队此时也发挥出了巨大的杀伤力，五十个小妖，除了小狐妖还有四十九个普遍比周围蛇妖要高出两个档次力量的小妖集中在一起就如同一个战场绞肉机一般，靠近他们的蛇妖就没有一个活下来的，个别实力强的蛇妖靠近也会被四五个二十三队弟兄同时出手击杀，巨大的三角战阵冲过蛇妖军之后就只留下一地的尸体。

水脏洞妖军和蛇妖军人数相差不大，混世魔王和青蛇王两个可以左右战局的高手又都在高空之中交手，所以整个战场处于一种胶着的状态。
content_en:
"Woo...Woo...Woo...Woo..." The majestic but shrill sound of the unfamiliar horn echoed in Kanyuan Mountain. When Lei Hao in the mountain heard it, his expression changed, and he quickly summoned his 23 teams and rushed towards the training ground outside the cave.

Lei Hao entered the group of demons and stood still. He saw that fewer and fewer demon soldiers rushed out of the cave and rushed in. The horn on the stone platform was still blowing, which confirmed Lei Hao's thoughts.Maybe, probably, we will attack the Snake Demon Cave today.

Lei Hao's heart sank a little bit. He didn't know if the battle formation he was practicing would be useful. How many of his fifty brothers would survive today? He really didn't know if he would survive.

The battlefield, a battlefield full of endless variables, could he, a college student living in the 21st century society, fully grasp it?But one change could leave him and all the brothers in Team 23 on the battlefield.

A tall figure slowly appeared in the shadow at the entrance of Shuizang Cave. When the clear sunlight shone on the figure's clothes and reflected dazzling light, Lei Hao cheered in his heart at the fierce momentum that surged out.

The first supporting character to appear in Journey to the West, the famous hybrid demon king, now looks so majestic and terrifying, full of the pressure of a king.

Feeling this coercion, Lei Hao muttered in his heart, "Is this the Hunshi Demon King or the Bull Demon King? He looks so awesome. The fruits of this world are really deep. You can't believe all Wu Dada's books, otherwise you won't know how you died."

"My sons, the group of softies in the Snake Demon Cave have repeatedly invaded my water-dirty cave and killed many monsters in my water-dirty cave. Today, the king will take you to kill those group of cartilages." The voice of the Demon King was very rich, but indifferent and almost devoid of any emotion. His speech was not fast, but it had the flavor of demagoguery.

"Follow the king and kill the weaklings." As soon as the demon king finished speaking, the demon soldiers below him immediately became excited. Even Lei Hao almost shouted along. Feeling that something was not right, he restrained himself with strong willpower. He turned around and saw the 50 little demons under his command. They were all shouting at the top of their lungs, and the little fox was screaming.Lei Hao was afraid in his heart, "What a terrible temptation." Lei Hao didn't want anyone to control his thinking, not even for a second.

"Let's go." Demon King Hunshi shouted and directly set up a burst of black demonic wind to roll up more than 3,000 demonic troops in Shuizhang Cave and fly away to the north.

Lei Hao was floating in the dark demonic wind, and his consciousness was a little unclear, but he was shouting in his heart: "Nima, you're cheating me, is this the Demon King who was crushed to death by Brother Monkey as soon as he appeared on the scene? Are you sure this is not the Bull Demon King? Not the Green Lion King? Not the Nine Spirits Yuansheng? Is this just a little Demon King?"

When Lei Hao came back to his senses, he saw a cave in the distance, with three characters "Snake Demon Cave" written on the cave.There is also a large open space under the feet like the training ground in front of Shuizang Cave.There was a vast plain around, and Lei Hao secretly made a gesture to Niu Jiujiu and Little Fox behind him, and the demon soldiers quickly and cleverly approached to form the battle formation they had been training for several days.With Lei Hao's reason for training them to form a formation, it didn't take much time to practice this battle formation and it was basically formed. It's just that whether it works or not will not be known until later.The brothers behind Lei Hao didn't notice, his palms were wet with sweat.

"Zhoutou, your Grandfather the Demon King has come to see you. Why don't you open the door to greet you?" The Demon King's voice is not loud, but it is as if he is speaking in your ear no matter how far away you are from him.

"Hiss... It turns out you are a turd-covered thing, and you dare to kill me in this cave... Hiss, are your injuries healed?" The cave door slowly opened, and the first person who walked out was not a green-faced and fanged monster, but a feminine middle-aged man.Just when he spoke, a long, narrow tongue with a forked tip came out of his mouth, much like a snake's tongue, and it looked particularly scary.He should be the Green Snake King.Following quietly behind the Snake Demon King were the little demons from the Snake Demon Cave. Countless little demons poured out from the side of the Green Snake King. After a while, they formed a demon army similar to that of the Shuizang Cave demon army.

When the Demon King Hunshi heard what the Green Snake King said about his injuries, he immediately became angry."You weakling, I don't want to use such rhetoric with you. Let's see the real deal with my hands!" After saying this, the Demon King struck out with a knife. When he raised his hand, the Demon King was still in front of the three thousand demon army in Shuizang Cave. When he slashed out, the Demon King's blade directly crossed the distance of hundreds of feet and appeared in the chest of the Green Snake King.

The Green Snake King's eyes flashed, "So you have made a breakthrough. No wonder you dare to knock on the door. Are you the Demon King? You are also the lowest among the Demon Kings."

A long sword with green light appeared out of thin air in the Green Snake King's right hand, which resisted the Demon King's sword, and a flash appeared directly in the sky.

"Demon King, I now admit that you are worthy of being my opponent. Come on, let me weigh your strength." A roaring sound came from high in the sky.

The Demon King, who was lightly blocked by the Green Demon King, had a gloomy look on his face, and shouted at the demons in the Shuizang Cave: "You guys, kill." Then he appeared in the air with a flash.Although the little demons from the Snake Demon Cave were right next to him, and even though he could kill a large number of snake demons like cutting wheat with one strike, the Demon King didn't even look at these snake demons.He is the demon king, and the demon king has the magnanimity of the demon king.

When the four commanders of Shuizhangdong heard the shouts of their king, they all shouted: "You guys, come with me and kill all these weaklings." Then, under the leadership of these four commanders, the three thousand little demons of Shuizhangdong rushed forward like a swarm of "Young and Dangerous" that Lei Hao watched in his previous life.Although Lei Hao had already thought of this scene, he was still stunned by the scene.

"Now I realize how terrible it is to be uneducated. These little monsters are not even qualified to be hooligans on earth. Even playing Warcraft on Earth requires human shields, damage output and treatment..." Lei Hao, who was crowded in the group of monsters, looked at this scene, but some messy thoughts came to his mind.

"Ninety-two cows, eighty-seven tigers, follow me closely, and the brothers behind me will also follow me... hack them to death." Lei Hao, who was greeting the demon soldiers behind him, suddenly thought of fighting in a group with those brothers on the earth. Isn't it the same way that he rushes forward without caring about anything, regardless of the enemy? The only difference is that this is not a fight, but a killing of the demons.

Getting closer, getting closer, Lei Hao could already clearly see the tiny scales and sharp fangs on the faces of the snake demons in the snake demon cave. His heartbeat was getting faster and faster, and the mace in his hand began to tremble slightly. The mace, which was usually as light as weight, now seemed to weigh several thousand kilograms.

"Do you really want to kill them? Do you really want to kill them?" The humanoid little demon easily made Lei Hao fall into a cage woven by the life of a river crab for more than twenty years in his previous life.

The Demon Army of Shuizang Cave and the Demon Army of Snake Demon Cave finally met, just like two big rivers coming from opposite directions after a lot of hardships and finally merged together, bursting out beautiful red waves.

Lei Hao finally broke out of the demon army's package in Shuizhang Cave. In his eyes, all the snake demons in the world seemed to squeeze into his sight.A monster soldier with black scales on his face and a snake-shaped lower body slashed at Lei Hao with a knife. The knife seemed to slow down in slow motion in Lei Hao's eyes. He could have killed the snake monster with his mace as long as he turned sideways, but Lei Hao's eyes flickered and he dodged the blade without swinging his mace.

It didn't matter that he hid, the knife struck directly on the left arm of Niu Jiujiu who was guarding Lei Hao on the right. Because Lei Hao didn't care about Niu Jiuzhu on the left, he obviously didn't understand what was going on. He took the knife on his left arm and turned his head to look at Lei Hao, his honest eyes a little confused.

Lei Hao was stunned for a moment. In his eyes, the whole world slowed down. Only the bright red blood spurting out from Niu Jiujiu's left shoulder kept making a 'ss' sound. Lei Hao's mind seemed to be shattered. He was stunned for a second, and thenFor a second, Lei Hao let out a howl like a wounded lone wolf rushing towards a group of lions: "Kill, kill, kill." He turned around and hit the black-faced snake demon with a mace, smashing the upper body of the snake demon into a ball of blood mist, and the lower half of his body flew towards the group of charging snake demons.

The snake demons were also shocked by this powerful attack, and they all looked at Lei Hao with some fear, but within a few seconds, the snake demons could not resist the desire to attack and rushed towards Lei Hao again.

In his madness, Lei Hao directly used his mace to draw out a black and shiny semicircle. Several puffs of blood mist burst out from the semicircle, and Lei Hao cleared a clearing. What an incredible thing it was in the center of the battlefield where demons were squeezing demons.

Here we have to talk about the strength of the little demon. The little demon is a deformed monster that was directly summoned by the enlightened demon king to summon beasts. It is a little ant at the bottom of the demon clan's strength pyramid.The fighting power of an average little demon is equivalent to that of an adult human man, and some are even worse. A little demon who has been simply trained has the strength of a human soldier and can fight two to three ordinary little demons.The little demon who is trained strictly uses military commanders who are at the third-rate level in ancient times.Can fight ten ordinary little monsters.People like Lei Hao are monsters. His power is already at the top of the list among little monsters. However, power is not equal to strength, and he may not be able to fully display it.

Occasionally, little demons have higher IQs, but they are fox demons, rabbit demons, and the like. They are inherently deficient, and their physical bodies cannot retain spiritual energy and have little development potential.It is difficult for monsters with physical talents such as tiger monsters, lion monsters, and bull monsters to have high IQs, and they simply don't know how to temper their physical bodies.There are very few little demons like Lei Hao who have both high IQ and strong body. There are even fewer little demons who can insist on beating the body like Lei Hao.

Lei Hao, who had blood-red eyes, swept out a semicircle with his mace without stopping. He waved the mace directly and rushed forward. Although he didn't have any stick skills, with Lei Hao's huge power, even the simplest direct hit, and the horizontal wheel also exerted terrifying lethality. He had never encountered an enemy who could catch his mace. The huge mace brought a blurry shadow flying up and down among the snake demon army.

At this time, the 23rd team led by Lei Hao in a triangular battle formation also exerted great lethality. The fifty little demons, in addition to the little fox demons, there were forty-nine little demons who were generally two levels stronger than the surrounding snake demons. They gathered together like a battlefield meat grinder. No snake demon that approached them survived. Individual strong snake demons that approached would be killed by four or five 23rd team brothers at the same time. After the huge triangular battle formation rushed through the snake demon army, only corpses were left on the ground.

The numbers of the Shuizangdong Demon Army and the Snake Demon Army are about the same. The two masters who can influence the situation of the battle, the Hunshi Demon King and the Green Snake King, are fighting at high altitude, so the entire battlefield is in a stalemate.
